jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, Revenue
jobs.description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

This is a full-time, flexible hybrid position based out of our Oakland, CA office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration. There is no mandate on the number of days required but we encourage employees to come in every week to collaborate.

About This Role

We're hiring a Senior Data Analyst, Revenue
to support our CFO and Finance organization on some of the most complex and consequential analytical problems at Fivetran. This role sits at the intersection of finance, data, and applied mathematics, with a focus on understanding, forecasting, and modeling the economic engine of the business.

You'll develop sophisticated models for revenue attribution, forecasting, customer behavior, and financial performance; build the underlying data infrastructure that powers company-wide reporting; and partner directly with Finance and executive leadership on decisions that shape the business.

This is a highly quantitative role for someone with exceptional numerical intuition, rigorous logical thinking, and an unusually high bar for accuracy. You'll work on problems where small errors can have meaningful downstream consequences, and where the best solution often requires going beyond standard reporting into mathematical modeling, statistical methods, or machine learning.

If you enjoy decomposing ambiguous business problems into precise mathematical frameworks, stress-testing assumptions, and building models that become foundational to how a company operates, this role offers the opportunity to work on some of our hardest analytical challenges.

Technologies You'll Use

SQL (BigQuery / Snowflake)
dbt / dbt State
Looker / LookML
Sigma / Hex / Google Sheets
Claude Code / Codex
Netsuite, CRM, and customer data and billing systems

What You'll Do

Develop sophisticated revenue models. Build, maintain, and improve complex mathematical models used to project, attribute, analyze, and understand Fivetran's revenue, customers, and underlying business drivers. Work in an environment with a strong emphasis on mathematical reasoning, robust logic, numerical precision, and analytical rigor.
Own revenue attribution and financial logic. Design frameworks that accurately connect revenue to customers, products, contracts, usage, and other business dimensions, including complex attribution problems that require careful mathematical treatment.
Build and improve revenue forecasting. Develop models that project revenue and customer behavior using historical trends, leading indicators, statistical methods, and machine learning. Continuously evaluate forecast accuracy and improve model performance over time.
Build scalable analytical infrastructure. Create data models, pipelines, and automated systems that are reliable, optimized, and scalable, enabling timely analytics and reporting for more than 2,000 stakeholders across the company.
Maintain an exceptionally high bar for quality. Develop rigorous validation, testing, and quality-assurance processes for financial data and analytical models. Identify edge cases, challenge assumptions, and ensure outputs can withstand scrutiny from Finance and executive leadership.
Partner closely with Finance leadership. Work directly with the CFO organization and cross-functional leaders to translate complex business questions into analytical frameworks, define business rules, establish metrics and targets, and communicate findings clearly.
Drive executive-level decision making. Conduct high-impact, in-depth analyses that inform company strategy, financial planning, resource allocation, growth initiatives, and other critical business decisions.
Embody ownership and operational excellence. Take responsibility for the correctness and reliability of your work, continuously improve existing systems and methodologies, and raise the analytical bar for the broader team.

Skills We're Looking For

4+ years of experience in analytics, data science, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
Advanced proficiency in SQL and data modeling, with experience working across large, complex datasets
Exceptional quantitative ability and numerical intuition, with a strong foundation in mathematics, logic, statistics, and analytical problem-solving
Experience using Looker, Tableau, Sigma, or similar business intelligence and visualization tools
Strong analytical judgment and a track record of translating ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations
Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for data quality, analytical rigor, and reproducibility
Excellent communication and data storytelling skills; you can make complex findings intuitive and help decision-makers understand not just what is happening, but why it matters and what to do next
Comfort operating in ambiguity, developing hypotheses, and owning analytical problems end-to-end
Strong cross-functional instincts and the ability to build trusted relationships with both technical and non-technical partners
A builder mindset: you look beyond answering one-off questions and create frameworks, datasets, and tools that make future decisions faster and better
Passion for using data to improve how organizations attract, develop, and support their people
Experience using analytics to support key business decisions, preferably at a high-growth, SaaS, or B2B product company

jobs.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

Concentric
is the first national industrial power services organization delivering forklift and critical power as well as maintenance solutions that ensure uninterrupted, sustainable facility power. The company’s signature solutions, Guaranteed POWER® and Perpetual POWER® are industry firsts, improving reliability, sustainability, and safety to solve the power problem for facility leaders. Concentric helps data centers, distributors, manufacturers, utilities, communications infrastructure and more develop resilience in their power systems while making the energy transition with less risk. With a national network of service professionals, Concentric provides engineering, installation and maintenance/management for power equipment including backup batteries, UPSs, generators, energy storage, micro grids, forklift power, onsite maintenance and more. Learn more at concentricusa.com.

Job Summary

The Field Technician,
Motive Power, is responsible for inspecting, maintaining, and repairing motive power equipment. This position conducts basic troubleshooting, field and shop repairs, and responds to customer needs. This position reports to the Regional Service Manager and does not have any direct reports.

Key Job Responsibilities:

Reliable attendance and punctuality.
Work safely, follow all safety regulations, including site specific safety regulations established by
customers.
Perform routine preventative maintenance.
Coordinate problem resolution with Technical Support, Customer Service, Sales, and other
personnel to expedite repairs.
Travel to other branches or sites, as required, to assist with product installation, removal or
repairs (some overnight travel will be required).
Comply with company policies and procedures. These include but are not limited to warranty,
safety, environmental, OSHA, DOT and Hazmat.
Build strong relationships with customers.
Take ownership of all company assets, including but not limited to vehicles, inventory, tools, and
equipment.
Troubleshoot battery and charger systems.
Perform repairs at customer locations and Concentric shops.
Respond to client needs in a timely manner, while applying great customer service.
Complete all service orders, PM worksheets, timecards, expense reports, and any documentation
as required, in an accurate and timely manner.
Work independently or with a team in a professional manner.
Other duties as assigned by supervisor

Key Performance Measurements:

A score card that reflects performance in areas such as safety, efficiency, work order completion, customer satisfaction, and issue resolution.
Exercises a high degree of time management skill, resulting in greater than 90% time billable to customers.
Management observation regarding attitude, diligence, team contributions, and willingness & ability to learn new skills and information.
Other key performance measurements as determined by the direct supervisor.

Requirements

High School or GED required.
Certification from a technical school focused on electrical, mechanical repair or battery
maintenance preferred.
Associate degree from an approved two-year college or university, preferred or equivalent
experience.
Must be able to pass a background check and drug screen.
Possess a valid driver’s license, CDL a plus but not required.
May be required to pass additional requirements under the Department of Transportation (DOT).
Working knowledge of basic AC and DC electrical/electronic theory.
Strong communication, problem solving, and analytical skills.
Ability to organize his/her own work and work independently, with limited supervision.
Ability to work with individuals from diverse backgrounds and with diverse needs, and across
remote offices.
Ability to clearly articulate ideas (both written and verbal) to both internal and external customers
and to listen effectively to customer needs.
Ability to develop and maintain strong workplace relationships with an emphasis on customer
satisfaction.
Ability to work collaboratively with other departments toward the greater good of the
organization.
Ability to adapt to a fast-changing environment.
Experience in material handling environment is preferred, but not required.
Willingness to work occasional overtime.
Travel daily, some overnight travel required.

Concentric Technicians
May Need To Travel Out Of State To Perform Work. The Department Of Transportation (DOT) Has Several Requirements For Drivers Of commercial Motor Vehicles
weighing Less Than 26,001 Pounds Who Are Driving Across State Lines, Including:

Drivers must be at least 18 years old to drive "Intrastate". Drivers must be at least 21 years old to driver "Interstate".
Drivers must have a valid driver's license at all times.
Drivers must have a valid DOT medical card or the ability to obtain DOT medical card per DOT/FMCA guidelines during the hiring process. Drivers must continue to maintain their active medical card status throughout their employment.
Drivers must follow the DOT's HOS regulations.
Drivers must be able to obtain a CDL to drive commercial motor vehicles or combination vehicles weighing more than 26,000 lbs.

Competitive pay – Plus incentive opportunities and overtime potential for our hourly employees!

Employee paid dental and vision insurance that starts on day one.
Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contribution on eligible High-Deductible Health Plans (HDHP).

8 paid holidays.

We offer employee paid accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity insurance.
We offer employee paid legal plans, identity protection, pet insurance, and home & auto discounts.
Training and mentoring – Learn from our experts in the industry.
Advancement opportunities.

Bellevue | Hybrid - 4 Days per week in office

We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Engineer
to help enterprise customers deploy, integrate, and scale an AI platform within complex technical environments.
This is a highly technical, customer-facing role that combines Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, and Implementation Consulting. You'll work directly with customer developers, architects, AI teams, and business stakeholders to drive successful deployments, solve technical challenges, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Lead enterprise implementations from kickoff through production deployment
Work directly with customer engineering teams to integrate APIs, applications, workflows, and AI platforms
Serve as the primary technical advisor during implementation and ongoing customer success activities
Utilize Python to troubleshoot integrations, validate deployments, analyze data, and support customer environments
Build MVP integrations and proof-of-concepts for new customer requirements and emerging AI technologies
Develop and validate new integrations using Python and APIs before partnering with Engineering to build production-ready support
Work closely with customers to understand new AI tools, models, and platforms they are adopting

Experience working directly with software developers and engineering teams

Brief Job Description

The Texas Health and Specialty Care System (HSCS) is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Analyst to join the Office of Forensic Services and Coordination (OFSC). In this essential role, the Data Analyst will support and enhance data reporting, analytics, and operational processes across the forensic service continuum. The position is responsible for maintaining and improving existing reporting products, identifying opportunities to automate workflows, optimizing data extraction and reporting processes, and supporting data-informed decision-making through analysis and visualization of complex datasets.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong foundation in data analytics, reporting, and statistical analysis, with experience working with large datasets and developing solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and accessibility of information. This position will work closely with program staff, leadership, and data partners to support ongoing reporting needs, improve data quality, and identify innovative approaches to strengthen business processes and reporting capabilities. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, effective collaboration, and a commitment to continuous learning and professional development in emerging data tools and technologies.

The Data Analyst works under the direction of OFSC’s data analyst on the policy, planning, research and coordination team within the OFSC with moderate latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgement to ensure the statutorily mandated duties of the Forensic Director (SB 1507, 84th Legislature, Regular Session, 2015) are met. These duties include statewide coordination and oversight of forensic services; coordination of forensic programs operated by HHSC; and addressing issues with the delivery of forensic services in Texas including significant increases in populations with serious mental illness and criminal justice system involvement. The Data Analyst will be expected to be a motivated self-starter.

The salary will be offered in accordance with the salary range posted for this position. Salary requests outside of the range in the posting will not be considered and is non-negotiable. For internal applicants, salary negotiations must align with the HHS Human Resources Manual and align with the salary range for this posting. For internal applicants, salary requests beyond the salary range in this posting or that require higher level approvals will not be considered.

Essential Job Functions (EJFs)

Data Analysis Reporting and Dashboard Support: Maintains, enhances, and supports reporting products, dashboards, and analytical tools used across the forensic service continuum. Performs analysis of complex datasets to identify operational trends, performance measures, and outcomes. Creates reports, visualizations, and data summaries that support business operations and data-informed decision-making. Assists in translating technical findings into understandable information for leadership and program staff.

(25%)

Data Automation and Process Improvement: Identifies opportunities to automate recurring reports, data collection activities, and business processes to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort. Develops and improves automated workflows, data refresh processes, validation routines, and reporting solutions. Collaborates with team members to streamline existing processes and implement sustainable, scalable data solutions. (20%)

Query Development and Data Management: Develops, maintains, and optimizes SQL queries, datasets, and reporting logic supporting forensic programs. Reviews and improves existing queries and processes to enhance performance, accuracy, and reliability. Assists with documenting data definitions, business rules, and reporting methodologies to ensure consistency and sustainability of reporting products. (15%)

Fielding Data Requests: Supports internal and external data requests by gathering requirements, conducting analyses, and delivering accurate and timely information. Works closely with HSCS leadership and staff to understand business needs and develop appropriate reporting solutions. Ensures all activities comply with applicable confidentiality, privacy, and data security requirements. (15%)

Collaboration and Data Quality Improvement: Collaborates with data partners across HSCS, Behavioral Health Services, state hospitals, state supported living centers, and other stakeholders to improve data quality, consistency, and reporting capabilities. Assists in identifying data discrepancies, conducting validation activities, and developing recommendations for process improvements that strengthen data integrity and program outcomes. (10%)

Policy Research and Evaluation: Support the development of studies, policy research, and evaluations. Partner with agency leadership and staff, universities, and stakeholders to support research and evaluation projects. (5%)

Training, Documentation, and Knowledge Sharing: Develops and maintains documentation related to reports, datasets, processes, and reporting tools. Assists in training staff on reporting products and data resources. Shares knowledge and best practices to promote effective use of data across the organization. (5%)

Continuous Professional Development: Stay current with advancements in data analytics, forensic policy, and relevant legislation. Participate in professional development opportunities, conferences, and training sessions to enhance skills and knowledge. Share insights and best practices with colleagues to foster a culture of continuous improvement within the OFSC. (5%)

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities (KSAs)

Knowledge of data analytics principles, statistical concepts, and techniques used to analyze, interpret, and communicate findings from complex datasets.

Knowledge of relational databases, data models, database design concepts, and data governance practices.

Experience using SQL, Tableau, Excel, or similar business intelligence and reporting tools to develop reports, dashboards, and data visualizations.

Experience working with healthcare, behavioral health, forensic mental health services, electronic health records, or other large operational data systems.

Skill in developing, maintaining, and optimizing SQL queries, data extracts, and reporting processes.

Skill in analyzing problems, identifying opportunities for process improvement, and developing effective data-driven solutions.

Ability to compile, review, validate, and analyze data while maintaining a high level of accuracy, attention to detail, and data integrity.

Ability to prepare reports, dashboards, presentations, and data visualizations and communicate technical findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Ability and willingness to learn emerging technologies, automation tools, and advanced analytics techniques to enhance reporting capabilities, improve operational efficiency, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

High degree of integrity, ability to build trust and communicate effectively.

Ability to work the hours of 8 a.m.-5 p.m., Monday through Friday with flexibility to be available after hours as needed such as during Legislative Sessions.

Registrations, Licensure Requirements Or Certifications

N/A

Initial Screening Criteria

A bachelors, masters degree or doctoral degree from an accredited university in one of the following disciplines: data science, computer science, business administration, business analytics, public administration, information technology or mathematics. Other disciplines will be considered based on relevant coursework and experience.

Demonstrated experience in data analytics and research, with expertise in statistical modeling to identify patterns and trends in existing datasets.

Experience in managing complex datasets.

Brief Job Description

The Data Analyst V performs highly complex (senior-level) data analysis, statistical modeling, visualization, and reporting of results to support program, policy, and financial decision-making within Long-Term Services and Supports (LTSS) section of the Provider Finance Department (PFD). The role works under limited supervision with moderate latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment. The Data Analyst V consults with internal and external stakeholders to identify analytics needs, integrates diverse data sources, resolves data anomalies, and communicates findings in clear, actionable formats for technical and non-technical audiences. This position serves as a team lead and may coordinate the work of other analysts.

Essential Job Functions (EJFs)

Performs Highly Complex Data Analysis, Financial Modeling, & Visualization – 35%

Collects, integrates, queries, cleans, and analyzes large and complex data sets using standard and advanced languages and analytics software such as SQL, MS Excel, SAS, Python, or R.
Builds and maintains dashboards and visualizations to identify significant differences, patterns, and trends that inform decisions.
Supports highly complex calculations and financial modeling for rate methodology development, fiscal estimates, and utilization analyses.
Leads cost report development.

Ensures Data Quality
& Data Integrity Improvement – 20%

Develops standards, usage guidelines, and procedures for data analysis tools and software.
Defines, develops, and implements data and reporting standards to improve consistency, repeatability, and auditability of analyses.
Establishes and maintains standard work procedures governing the appropriate use of data and reporting artifacts (templates, definitions, metadata).
Reviews the work of colleagues and members of other teams for accuracy, completeness, and conformance with standards, policies, and procedures.
Develops data quality measures, analyzes data quality results, and implements necessary changes to ensure data quality improvement.
Identifies data gaps, errors, anomalies, inconsistencies, and redundancies by analyzing the content, structure, and relationships within data.
Partners with stakeholders to remediate root causes of data issues and to strengthen upstream processes and controls.

Leads Internal and External Stakeholder Outreach and Communication Initiatives – 20%

Collaborates with program, policy, research, and cost report teams to respond to requests for information related to rates, services, providers, funding, and utilization.
Develops concise, comprehensive reports and presentations to interpret results, identify alternatives, and make and justify recommendations for internal and external stakeholders.
Initiates departmental learning initiatives, leads training and information-sharing sessions, and presents Data Analysis and Calculations (DAC) team findings at departmental seminars.
Communicates data insights to internal and external stakeholders using clear language and appropriate visual formatting.

Facilitates Data Model Development and Automation – 10%

Develops data models and data management and analysis tools.
Guides the selection of data management and analysis tools and provides input to leadership on application and software adoption.
Facilitates automation and efficiency initiatives and recognizes opportunities for automation of standardized and ad hoc processes, projects, and reports.

Demonstrates Leadership, Delegates Tasks, and Ensures Timely Project Completion – 10%

Coordinates analytic work, delegates tasks, and ensures work products meet deadlines and quality expectations.
Assists DAC manager as liaison for cross-team data analysis projects and ensures within-team conformance to departmental needs, standards, and best practices.
Serves as lead, mentors junior staff, supports training, and is available to answer questions and assist others when needed.

Other related work as assigned – 5%

Performs other related work as assigned in support of LTSS Provider Finance priorities.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities (KSAs)

Knowledge of statistics, data set analysis, running queries, report writing, presenting findings, and record keeping, including security procedures for handling, protecting, and distributing confidential data.
Knowledge of data models, database design development, data mining, and segmentation techniques.
Skills in the use of a computer and applicable software, conducting data searches, evaluating and translating large amounts of data, and critical thinking.

Preferred: knowledge of Texas Medicaid reimbursement policy/rules and experience with Health and Human Services data; strong analytical mindset when working with large government program data.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, Revenue
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

This is a full-time, flexible hybrid position based out of our New York, NY office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration. There is no mandate on the number of days required but we encourage employees to come in every week to collaborate.

About This Role

We’re hiring a Senior Data Analyst, Revenue
to support our CFO and Finance organization on some of the most complex and consequential analytical problems at Fivetran. This role sits at the intersection of finance, data, and applied mathematics, with a focus on understanding, forecasting, and modeling the economic engine of the business.

You’ll develop sophisticated models for revenue attribution, forecasting, customer behavior, and financial performance; build the underlying data infrastructure that powers company-wide reporting; and partner directly with Finance and executive leadership on decisions that shape the business.

This is a highly quantitative role for someone with exceptional numerical intuition, rigorous logical thinking, and an unusually high bar for accuracy. You’ll work on problems where small errors can have meaningful downstream consequences, and where the best solution often requires going beyond standard reporting into mathematical modeling, statistical methods, or machine learning.

If you enjoy decomposing ambiguous business problems into precise mathematical frameworks, stress-testing assumptions, and building models that become foundational to how a company operates, this role offers the opportunity to work on some of our hardest analytical challenges.

Technologies You’ll Use

SQL (BigQuery / Snowflake)
dbt / dbt State
Looker / LookML
Sigma / Hex / Google Sheets
Claude Code / Codex
Netsuite, CRM, and customer data and billing systems

What You’ll Do

Develop sophisticated revenue models. Build, maintain, and improve complex mathematical models used to project, attribute, analyze, and understand Fivetran’s revenue, customers, and underlying business drivers. Work in an environment with a strong emphasis on mathematical reasoning, robust logic, numerical precision, and analytical rigor.
Own revenue attribution and financial logic. Design frameworks that accurately connect revenue to customers, products, contracts, usage, and other business dimensions, including complex attribution problems that require careful mathematical treatment.
Build and improve revenue forecasting. Develop models that project revenue and customer behavior using historical trends, leading indicators, statistical methods, and machine learning. Continuously evaluate forecast accuracy and improve model performance over time.
Build scalable analytical infrastructure. Create data models, pipelines, and automated systems that are reliable, optimized, and scalable, enabling timely analytics and reporting for more than 2,000 stakeholders across the company.
Maintain an exceptionally high bar for quality. Develop rigorous validation, testing, and quality-assurance processes for financial data and analytical models. Identify edge cases, challenge assumptions, and ensure outputs can withstand scrutiny from Finance and executive leadership.
Partner closely with Finance leadership. Work directly with the CFO organization and cross-functional leaders to translate complex business questions into analytical frameworks, define business rules, establish metrics and targets, and communicate findings clearly.
Drive executive-level decision making. Conduct high-impact, in-depth analyses that inform company strategy, financial planning, resource allocation, growth initiatives, and other critical business decisions.
Embody ownership and operational excellence. Take responsibility for the correctness and reliability of your work, continuously improve existing systems and methodologies, and raise the analytical bar for the broader team.

Skills We’re Looking For

4+ years of experience in analytics, data science, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
Advanced proficiency in SQL and data modeling, with experience working across large, complex datasets
Exceptional quantitative ability and numerical intuition, with a strong foundation in mathematics, logic, statistics, and analytical problem-solving
Experience using Looker, Tableau, Sigma, or similar business intelligence and visualization tools
Strong analytical judgment and a track record of translating ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations
Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for data quality, analytical rigor, and reproducibility
Excellent communication and data storytelling skills; you can make complex findings intuitive and help decision-makers understand not just what is happening, but why it matters and what to do next
Comfort operating in ambiguity, developing hypotheses, and owning analytical problems end-to-end
Strong cross-functional instincts and the ability to build trusted relationships with both technical and non-technical partners
A builder mindset: you look beyond answering one-off questions and create frameworks, datasets, and tools that make future decisions faster and better
Passion for using data to improve how organizations attract, develop, and support their people
Experience using analytics to support key business decisions, preferably at a high-growth, SaaS, or B2B product company

About The Opportunity

UHC Construction Services, a family-owned National Commercial General Contractor based in Northfield, Ohio, is seeking a Construction Project Coordinator to support the successful execution of commercial construction projects across the country.

This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving construction environment. The Project Coordinator will work closely with Project Managers, Superintendents, subcontractors, vendors, suppliers, and clients to keep projects organized, documented, and moving forward.

This is not a general office admin role. The Project Coordinator supports Project Managers while also owning assigned coordination tasks, follow-up items, documentation, and project communication. UHC is looking for someone who takes responsibility, follows through, and can shift priorities when urgent project needs arise.

UHC serves national retail, restaurant, hospitality, grocery, healthcare, automotive, and commercial clients through remodels, rollouts, build-outs, fixture and graphic installations, digital installations, and ground-up projects. The company offers long-term stability, national project exposure, and a collaborative team environment.

What You’ll Do

Support Project Managers with day-to-day coordination of multiple commercial construction projects from startup through closeout.
Assist with contract administration, change order processing, submittals, purchasing, cost coding, project documentation, and closeout.
Coordinate communication between Project Managers, Superintendents, subcontractors, vendors, suppliers, clients, and internal office teams.
Track project schedules, milestones, action items, materials, manpower, subcontractor activity, permits, inspections, deliveries, and closeout requirements.
Help gather and organize pricing, proposals, certificates of insurance, lien waivers, closeout documents, field reports, progress photos, and other project materials.
Maintain accurate project files, logs, drawings, specifications, digital documentation, and customer portal updates.
Review drawings, specifications, and scopes of work to support material ordering and scope verification.
Perform basic quantity checks or simple takeoffs for items such as flooring, tile, bathroom accessories, fixtures, or other vendor-supplied materials.
Help ensure subcontractors and vendors have the information they need to complete work safely, accurately, and on schedule.
Prioritize competing requests from multiple Project Managers, field teams, and project deadlines.
Escalate issues when information is missing, priorities conflict, or project execution is at risk.
Support a high-volume workflow across multiple commercial projects and national client accounts.

Required Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

2+ years of experience in construction coordination, project administration, subcontractor coordination, facilities coordination, trade coordination, or a related construction support role.
Experience communicating with subcontractors, vendors, suppliers, field teams, or project teams.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, requests, and follow-up items at once.
Clear, professional communication skills by phone, email, and internal systems.
Strong attention to detail and comfort maintaining accurate project records.
Ability to read, organize, and track construction documents, project scopes, specifications, or plans.
Ability to work full-time from UHC’s Northfield, OH office.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, email, spreadsheets, and digital project documentation tools.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience as a Project Coordinator, Construction Coordinator, Project Administrator, Facilities Coordinator, or similar role.
Experience in commercial construction, retail construction, restaurant construction, hospitality, national rollouts, remodels, or fast-paced tenant improvement work.
Experience working for a general contractor, subcontractor, trade contractor, signage company, HVAC contractor, electrical contractor, window/siding company, facilities company, or similar construction-related business.
Familiarity with construction schedules, subcontractor scopes, RFIs, submittals, change orders, cost coding, purchase orders, daily reports, and closeout documentation.
Ability to read basic blueprints or willingness to learn how to review drawings and specifications for material ordering.
Experience with Sage, Monday.com, Airtable, Excel, Word, Microsoft Project, customer portals, or similar construction/project management systems.
Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field is preferred but not required.

What Makes Someone Successful Here

You can stay organized while supporting several active projects at once.
You know how to follow up without letting details fall through the cracks.
You can stop one task, handle an urgent field or subcontractor issue, then return to your original work.
You understand that the loudest request is not always the most important request.
You are comfortable asking questions, escalating issues, and taking ownership of your assigned work.

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. This is a full-time, flexible hybrid position based out of our Oakland, CA office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration. There is no mandate on the number of days required but we encourage employees to come in every week to collaborate.

About This Role

We're hiring a Senior Data Analyst, Revenue
to support our CFO and Finance organization on some of the most complex and consequential analytical problems at Fivetran. This role sits at the intersection of finance, data, and applied mathematics, with a focus on understanding, forecasting, and modeling the economic engine of the business.

You'll develop sophisticated models for revenue attribution, forecasting, customer behavior, and financial performance; build the underlying data infrastructure that powers company-wide reporting; and partner directly with Finance and executive leadership on decisions that shape the business.

This is a highly quantitative role for someone with exceptional numerical intuition, rigorous logical thinking, and an unusually high bar for accuracy. You'll work on problems where small errors can have meaningful downstream consequences, and where the best solution often requires going beyond standard reporting into mathematical modeling, statistical methods, or machine learning.

If you enjoy decomposing ambiguous business problems into precise mathematical frameworks, stress-testing assumptions, and building models that become foundational to how a company operates, this role offers the opportunity to work on some of our hardest analytical challenges.

Technologies You'll Use

SQL (BigQuery / Snowflake)
dbt / dbt State
Looker / LookML
Sigma / Hex / Google Sheets
Claude Code / Codex
Netsuite, CRM, and customer data and billing systems

What You'll Do

Develop sophisticated revenue models. Build, maintain, and improve complex mathematical models used to project, attribute, analyze, and understand Fivetran's revenue, customers, and underlying business drivers. Work in an environment with a strong emphasis on mathematical reasoning, robust logic, numerical precision, and analytical rigor.
Own revenue attribution and financial logic. Design frameworks that accurately connect revenue to customers, products, contracts, usage, and other business dimensions, including complex attribution problems that require careful mathematical treatment.
Build and improve revenue forecasting. Develop models that project revenue and customer behavior using historical trends, leading indicators, statistical methods, and machine learning. Continuously evaluate forecast accuracy and improve model performance over time.
Build scalable analytical infrastructure. Create data models, pipelines, and automated systems that are reliable, optimized, and scalable, enabling timely analytics and reporting for more than 2,000 stakeholders across the company.
Maintain an exceptionally high bar for quality. Develop rigorous validation, testing, and quality-assurance processes for financial data and analytical models. Identify edge cases, challenge assumptions, and ensure outputs can withstand scrutiny from Finance and executive leadership.
Partner closely with Finance leadership. Work directly with the CFO organization and cross-functional leaders to translate complex business questions into analytical frameworks, define business rules, establish metrics and targets, and communicate findings clearly.
Drive executive-level decision making. Conduct high-impact, in-depth analyses that inform company strategy, financial planning, resource allocation, growth initiatives, and other critical business decisions.
Embody ownership and operational excellence. Take responsibility for the correctness and reliability of your work, continuously improve existing systems and methodologies, and raise the analytical bar for the broader team.

Skills We're Looking For

4+ years of experience in analytics, data science, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
Advanced proficiency in SQL and data modeling, with experience working across large, complex datasets
Exceptional quantitative ability and numerical intuition, with a strong foundation in mathematics, logic, statistics, and analytical problem-solving
Experience using Looker, Tableau, Sigma, or similar business intelligence and visualization tools
Strong analytical judgment and a track record of translating ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations
Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for data quality, analytical rigor, and reproducibility
Excellent communication and data storytelling skills; you can make complex findings intuitive and help decision-makers understand not just what is happening, but why it matters and what to do next
Comfort operating in ambiguity, developing hypotheses, and owning analytical problems end-to-end
Strong cross-functional instincts and the ability to build trusted relationships with both technical and non-technical partners
A builder mindset: you look beyond answering one-off questions and create frameworks, datasets, and tools that make future decisions faster and better
Passion for using data to improve how organizations attract, develop, and support their people
Experience using analytics to support key business decisions, preferably at a high-growth, SaaS, or B2B product company

Founded by Sam Saiia as Birmingham Excavating Co. in 1946, the company now known as Saiia Construction is an industrial heavy civil contractor of choice for the power generation, mineral and aggregate mining, and pulp and paper markets. With more than 630 pieces of construction machinery in our fleet, over 500 employees, and experience working in 11 states, we have the resources and knowledge to complete projects of any scale. Downloads digital images and data from survey equipment into surveying software programs.
Observes excavating activities to verify conformance to stake references and notifies equipment operators or supervisor of deviations.

Knowledge of topographic surveys, Civil construction drawings, specifications, profiles, & details, construction surveying, construction layout for water, sewer, and storm drainage.
Proficient with computer systems including MS Office Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
Preferred - Strong understanding of surveying mathematics, data adjustment, surface models, analyzing quality of data, and processing data.

Must be detail oriented and can deal with problems involving several variables in non-standard situations.
Must have excellent organizational and time management skills.
Ability to communicate effectively in written and verbal correspondence.

Ability to work independently or within a team environment.

Ability to work overtime as required.

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

This is a full-time, flexible hybrid position based out of our New York, NY office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration. There is no mandate on the number of days required but we encourage employees to come in every week to collaborate.

About This Role

We’re hiring a Senior Data Analyst, Revenue
to support our CFO and Finance organization on some of the most complex and consequential analytical problems at Fivetran. This role sits at the intersection of finance, data, and applied mathematics, with a focus on understanding, forecasting, and modeling the economic engine of the business.

You’ll develop sophisticated models for revenue attribution, forecasting, customer behavior, and financial performance; build the underlying data infrastructure that powers company-wide reporting; and partner directly with Finance and executive leadership on decisions that shape the business.

This is a highly quantitative role for someone with exceptional numerical intuition, rigorous logical thinking, and an unusually high bar for accuracy. You’ll work on problems where small errors can have meaningful downstream consequences, and where the best solution often requires going beyond standard reporting into mathematical modeling, statistical methods, or machine learning.

If you enjoy decomposing ambiguous business problems into precise mathematical frameworks, stress-testing assumptions, and building models that become foundational to how a company operates, this role offers the opportunity to work on some of our hardest analytical challenges.

Technologies You’ll Use

SQL (BigQuery / Snowflake)
dbt / dbt State
Looker / LookML
Sigma / Hex / Google Sheets
Claude Code / Codex
Netsuite, CRM, and customer data and billing systems

What You’ll Do

Develop sophisticated revenue models. Build, maintain, and improve complex mathematical models used to project, attribute, analyze, and understand Fivetran’s revenue, customers, and underlying business drivers. Work in an environment with a strong emphasis on mathematical reasoning, robust logic, numerical precision, and analytical rigor.
Own revenue attribution and financial logic. Design frameworks that accurately connect revenue to customers, products, contracts, usage, and other business dimensions, including complex attribution problems that require careful mathematical treatment.
Build and improve revenue forecasting. Develop models that project revenue and customer behavior using historical trends, leading indicators, statistical methods, and machine learning. Continuously evaluate forecast accuracy and improve model performance over time.
Build scalable analytical infrastructure. Create data models, pipelines, and automated systems that are reliable, optimized, and scalable, enabling timely analytics and reporting for more than 2,000 stakeholders across the company.

Construction Project Coordinator

Support Fast-Paced Commercial Projects Nationwide

Company:
UHC Construction Services

Location:
Northfield, OH

Employment Type
: Full-Time

Work Model
: In-office

Salary:
$55,000–$65,000 per year, depending on experience﻿

Project Scope:
National commercial general contracting

Licenses / Certifications:
None required

About The Opportunity

UHC Construction Services, a family-owned National Commercial General Contractor based in Northfield, Ohio, is seeking a Construction Project Coordinator to support the successful execution of commercial construction projects across the country.

This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving construction environment. The Project Coordinator will work closely with Project Managers, Superintendents, subcontractors, vendors, suppliers, and clients to keep projects organized, documented, and moving forward.

This is not a general office admin role. The Project Coordinator supports Project Managers while also owning assigned coordination tasks, follow-up items, documentation, and project communication. UHC is looking for someone who takes responsibility, follows through, and can shift priorities when urgent project needs arise.

UHC serves national retail, restaurant, hospitality, grocery, healthcare, automotive, and commercial clients through remodels, rollouts, build-outs, fixture and graphic installations, digital installations, and ground-up projects. The company offers long-term stability, national project exposure, and a collaborative team environment.

What You’ll Do

Support Project Managers with day-to-day coordination of multiple commercial construction projects from startup through closeout.
Assist with contract administration, change order processing, submittals, purchasing, cost coding, project documentation, and closeout.
Coordinate communication between Project Managers, Superintendents, subcontractors, vendors, suppliers, clients, and internal office teams.
Track project schedules, milestones, action items, materials, manpower, subcontractor activity, permits, inspections, deliveries, and closeout requirements.
Help gather and organize pricing, proposals, certificates of insurance, lien waivers, closeout documents, field reports, progress photos, and other project materials.
Maintain accurate project files, logs, drawings, specifications, digital documentation, and customer portal updates.
Review drawings, specifications, and scopes of work to support material ordering and scope verification.
Perform basic quantity checks or simple takeoffs for items such as flooring, tile, bathroom accessories, fixtures, or other vendor-supplied materials.
Help ensure subcontractors and vendors have the information they need to complete work safely, accurately, and on schedule.
Prioritize competing requests from multiple Project Managers, field teams, and project deadlines.
Escalate issues when information is missing, priorities conflict, or project execution is at risk.
Support a high-volume workflow across multiple commercial projects and national client accounts.

Required Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

2+ years of experience in construction coordination, project administration, subcontractor coordination, facilities coordination, trade coordination, or a related construction support role.
Experience communicating with subcontractors, vendors, suppliers, field teams, or project teams.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, requests, and follow-up items at once.
Clear, professional communication skills by phone, email, and internal systems.
Strong attention to detail and comfort maintaining accurate project records.
Ability to read, organize, and track construction documents, project scopes, specifications, or plans.
Ability to work full-time from UHC’s Northfield, OH office.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, email, spreadsheets, and digital project documentation tools.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience as a Project Coordinator, Construction Coordinator, Project Administrator, Facilities Coordinator, or similar role.
Experience in commercial construction, retail construction, restaurant construction, hospitality, national rollouts, remodels, or fast-paced tenant improvement work.
Experience working for a general contractor, subcontractor, trade contractor, signage company, HVAC contractor, electrical contractor, window/siding company, facilities company, or similar construction-related business.
Familiarity with construction schedules, subcontractor scopes, RFIs, submittals, change orders, cost coding, purchase orders, daily reports, and closeout documentation.
Ability to read basic blueprints or willingness to learn how to review drawings and specifications for material ordering.
Experience with Sage, Monday.com, Airtable, Excel, Word, Microsoft Project, customer portals, or similar construction/project management systems.
Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field is preferred but not required.

What Makes Someone Successful Here

You can stay organized while supporting several active projects at once.
You know how to follow up without letting details fall through the cracks.
You can stop one task, handle an urgent field or subcontractor issue, then return to your original work.
You understand that the loudest request is not always the most important request.
You are comfortable asking questions, escalating issues, and taking ownership of your assigned work.
You enjoy being part of a team that moves quickly and values practical problem-solving.
You want a stable, long-term opportunity in construction operations.

This emphasis reflects the call feedback: UHC wants someone who can prioritize competing PM and field requests, take ownership of their side of the project, and operate with responsibility rather than needing heavy micromanagement.

Compensation & Benefits

$55,000–$65,000 annual salary, depending on experience.
Full-time position.
401(k) retirement savings program.
Profit sharing.
Health, dental, and vision insurance.
Paid vacation / PTO.
Referral bonus program.
Company events, outings, and annual trips.
Training and certification opportunities, including manufacturer training, OSHA, fall protection, lift certifications, and construction-related development.

Client confirmed the $55K–$65K range during the onboarding call and noted they currently have multiple people in this role/range.

Growth & Development

UHC provides opportunities for team members to build construction knowledge over time. Project Coordinators may gain exposure to project management workflows, blueprint reading, scheduling, vendor coordination, client communication, and commercial construction operations.

UHC also discussed partnering with Akron College for construction-related certificate training, including blueprint reading and scheduling. The client stated UHC pays upfront for this training.

About UHC Construction Services

UHC Construction Services is a family-owned National Commercial General Contractor headquartered in Northfield, Ohio. Founded in 2006, UHC specializes in commercial construction projects across retail, restaurant, hospitality, grocery, automotive, healthcare, and other commercial sectors.

UHC’s work includes rollouts, live remodels, new build-outs, fixture and graphic installations, digital installations, and project management for national commercial clients. The company combines national construction expertise with a collaborative, service-focused, family-owned culture.

It is UHC’s intention that all qualified applicants are given equal opportunity and that selection decisions are based on job-related factors.

Are you a compassionate healthcare professional with a passion for wound care, eager to align your expertise with your personal values? At Encompass Health, you'll experience the difference the moment you become a part of our team. At Encompass Health, we are committed to creating a supportive, inclusive, and caring environment where you can thrive. From day one,
you will have access to:

Affordable medical, dental, and vision plans for both full-time and part-time employees and their families.
Generous paid time off that accrues over time.
Opportunities for tuition reimbursement and continuous education.
Company-matching 401(k) and employee stock purchase plans.
Flexible spending and health savings accounts.
A vibrant community of individuals passionate about the work they do!

Become the Wound Program Coordinator you always wanted to be

Oversee and develop wound care services in adherence to regulatory standards and physician orders.
Collaborate with clinical teams to provide guidance on wound care treatments.
Lead educational efforts for hospital staff on wound care topics, as well as educating patient and family members on wounds and wound care.
Maintain continuous education and stay updated on the latest wound care techniques and advancements.

Qualifications

License/Certification: RN, Physical Therapist, or Occupational Therapist required for acute rehab hospitals; RN required for long-term acute care hospitals.
CPR certification is mandatory.
Education & Experience:
Minimum one year of wound care experience is required.
Continuous education in wound care through seminars/professional organizations is required.
